children: Portable Beacons do nothing more than transmit signals that can be received only by sensors. A single Portable Beacon is about 1 meter long. One end is pointed, making the beacon easy to embed in the ground, but a beacon also features a built-in tripod, enabling the beacon up be set up on a hard, flat surface. Able to transmit a signal to a range of 10,000 km from a planet's surface, a Portable Beacon is commonly used to mark the location of a safe landing zone.
